psychological_meaning: Iceberg evokes feelings of tranquility, clarity, and freshness. It is reminiscent of glacial landscapes, symbolizing purity, coolness, and a sense of calm expansiveness. This color can also represent new beginnings, cleanliness, and a refreshing perspective.
